external_exception.note: The ONLY admissible incompleteness is a genuine third-party external (pentest, SOC 2 / ISO 27001, cyber-insurance, counsel/patent sign-off, or a live deploy credential not held in-repo) — declared honestly in the readiness ledger, never faked (§0.29 + §0.2).
